errors.evidence: The description fails to mention a key part of the chart's purpose, which is the vulnerability "towards undeclared employment" (към недекларирана заетост), as stated in the chart's title.

The description claims the horizontal axis shows the "number of respondents", but the chart provides no units for the values on the axis. The provided figure caption even suggests the unit might be percentage, contradicting this claim.
The chart is a horizontal bar chart, so the bars have 'lengths' (дължини), not 'heights' (височини).
The description states that the color of the bars depends on the category. It is more accurate to say that the color depends on the value of the bar (the higher the value, the lighter the color).
